svg.title: Waking from sleep with Wi-Fi off: median 1.25 s on 0.4.0 and 0.81 s on 0.4.1, 35% less measured resume time
svg.desc: Two horizontal bars. Median time from the kernel's first logged resume marker to the game's first rendered frame, with Wi-Fi off: 0.4.0, 1251 ms over 10 wakes (1236 to 1270); 0.4.1, timed as 0.4.1-beta.1 (the same runtime source apart from the version), 808 ms over 11 wakes (803 to 828). 443 ms sooner, 35% less measured time. The unlogged time from the lid starting to open until resume starts is not included, and this is not the kernel's total device-resume time. With 0.4.x's hidden wifi=on setting, both took about 0.82 s, and no improvement is claimed; that is not a measurement of 0.5.0's Wi-Fi On.

g.text: Median time from the start of resume to the game's first frame
From the kernel's first logged resume marker to the first rendered frame. Excludes
the unlogged time from the lid starting to open until that marker; not the kernel's
total device-resume time. 0.4.1 was timed as 0.4.1-beta.1, the same runtime source
apart from the version. With 0.4.x's hidden wifi=on setting, both took about 0.82 s;
that was a different setting, not a measurement of 0.5.0's Wi-Fi On.
